title: Fixture chat ID that no timestamp can contain
goal: The channel-state privacy test no longer depends on the clock
acceptance: The fixture chat ID cannot occur in an ISO timestamp, and the privacy assertion matches it
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20 from the CI log. Not a measurement.
